rules_shown.rule: When an object must be cooled and placed: search all countertops first, open them if closed, take the object, cool it with the fridge, move it to the target.
rules_shown.example: In the successful game, the agent searched countertop 2, took pan 1, cooled it with fridge 1, and moved it to diningtable 1.
rules_shown.validation: This game confirmed that searching cabinets and drawers is necessary, and the agent must open closed containers before taking objects. | This game confirmed that searching countertops first is necessary for finding objects to cool.
rules_shown.rendered_for_agent: [Success Process] When an object must be cooled and placed: search all countertops first, open them if closed, take the object, cool it with the fridge, move it to the target. rules_shown.rule: When searching for a cool plate to place in a cabinet, systematically check all countertops first before attempting to retrieve it from the fridge.
